title: 分层架构与替身测试：controller / service / repository
expected_output:
=== GET /api/users/{id} ===
  id=1   -> 200 {"id":1,"name":"alice","admin":true}
  id=1   -> 200 {"id":1,"name":"alice","admin":true}   (2nd call served from cache)
  id=2   -> 200 {"id":2,"name":"bob","admin":false}
  id=99  -> 404 {"error":"user 99 not found"}
  id=98  -> 500 {"error":"internal"}

=== accounting (all numbers derived from the run) ===
  total requests     : 5
  repository calls   : 4
  service cache hits : 1
  => the repeated id=1 never reached the repository again

=== DTO vs Entity: field sets read from the objects themselves ===
  entity columns (repo side) : [id, name, role]
  dto components (api side)  : [id, name, admin]
  entity-only, never serialized : [role]

=== error mapping belongs to the advice, not the controller body ===
  NoSuchElementException -> 404  (business: resource missing)
  other RuntimeException -> 500  (infrastructure: db unreachable)
  transaction boundary   -> service layer
